races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: MR MOONSHINE went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up at Southwell on his most recent outing, doing all he could from a hopeless position, and is plainly one to be interested in again. Fleur de Mer arrives in good order and heads up the opposition, along with Annandale , who could easily get back on track resuming from another break. MR MOONSHINE (IRE) FLEUR DE MER (IRE) ANNANDALE (IRE)

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: KARTINI still looks well treated on the pick of her form and can make it 2 wins from her last 3 starts. Class-dropper Humble Spark is feared most, with Rory's Gold and Regalian others to consider. KARTINI (IRE) HUMBLE SPARK (IRE) RORY'S GOLD (IRE)

races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BONDY BOY produced a promising first effort when runner-up on his recent debut at Southwell and should take plenty of beating with improvement on the cards. Maharry is the narrow pick of the 3 newcomers before market clues. BONDY BOY MAHARRY (IRE) MAIDEN'S BOWER (USA)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict: EAGLE STORM is drawn higher than ideal but looks open to further progress and can defy a 4 lb rise gained for making a winning nursery debut here. Court Legend has made a positive start in nurseries and remains with potential at this trip, whilst Benedetti should benefit for the step up to 1m on her first start in this company. EAGLE STORM COURT LEGEND BENEDETTI

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CORNICHON sets a good standard here on the basis of his 2 in-frame efforts and he's taken to get off the mark. The well-bred Debutante went with much promise dropped to this trip at Nottingham last time and she's the main threat, with Kalahari Flame perhaps completing the 1-2-3. CORNICHON (FR) DEBUTANTE KALAHARI FLAME

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict: AURADUE has fewer miles on the clock than her opposition here and she can defy a 4 lb rise to follow up from last month's Southwell success. Pivotal Terms went down by just a neck there and is respected meeting the selection on better terms, whilst Spun To Gold is interesting from this mark on his second outing after a break. AURADUE PIVOTAL TERMS SPUN TO GOLD (USA)

races.title: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict: OXFORD CIRCUS is really starting to find his feet for this yard and looks up to completing a hat-trick. Ice Show is worth another chance having shown improved form to score over C&D 2 starts back and is next best ahead of Kit Gabriel , who drops into a 0-65 for the first time. races.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict: ROARING RALPH could be worth chancing off his reduced mark in a wide-open finale. Showtime Mahomes was quickly back to form returned to all-weather last time and is second choice ahead of Too Much , who was just edged out over C&D at the same meeting. ROARING RALPH SHOWTIME MAHOMES TOO MUCH
